names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 decembrie, «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Auxentie», with the rank words left off.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ευστράτιος, Αυξέντιος, Ευγένιος, Μαρδάριος και Ορέστης», with the rank word left off. The page glosses the name itself, «(από το ρήμα αυξάνω) = ο μεγάλος».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 13. децембар ст. ст., „Свети мученици Евстратије, Аксентије, Евгеније, Мардарије и Орест.“ — with «Свети мученици» left off and the second of the five bare forenames taken; the «companion of Eustratius» of the display name is this corpus’s own and §6 keeps a clause naming another saint out of a stored form. THE FOLD THIS MAKES IS WRITTEN AND KEYED: `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the string at one other holder, `auxentius-of-bithynia`, and no READ_FOLDS key existed, so a new two-member key goes into `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in this commit — and the reading names the near thing, which is that the Bithynian is a `presbyter` too.

The calendar’s own name page for him is «Авксентий Севастийский, Аравийский, пресвитер, сщмч.»; the rank is stripped and the epithets kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

feast.note: The same menologion day this folder’s other rows already carry, so there is no second day and none is noted. The line is the joint feast of the five and all five folders already stood in the corpus, so this day is five rows and no arrival. The reading this calendar links behind the entry was NOT opened: this folder’s life is already written out of its other sources, and that is said here rather than claimed otherwise. THE LINE’S «(284-305)» IS WRITTEN AS A DATE WHERE THE FOLDER HAD NONE, as a traditional interval and not a year of death. The day page’s troparion of the martyrs is written on all five; its two kontakia name Eustratius and are written on his folder only.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 декабря ст. ст. — «Мчч. Евстратия, Авксентия, Евгения, Мардария и Ореста (284-305).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 decembrie — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Auxentie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ευστράτιος, Αυξέντιος, Ευγένιος, Μαρδάριος και Ορέστης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the corpus already keeps for the company, and the entry is the same five: the officer Eustratius and his fellows under Diocletian. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page names Λυσίας the duke and Ἀγρικόλας the eparch as their judges, and gives no year for the persecution beyond «επί Διοκλητιανού», so no `dates` are proposed from it. It lists at length where the relics are kept — Μεγίστη Λαύρα, Κουτλουμούσι, Ξηροπόταμος, Φιλοθέου, Καρακάλου and Κύκκου, Μικρόκαστρο of Siatista, Αρχάγγελος Μιχαήλ at Aridaia, and the greater part of all five at the church of the Holy Trinity and the Five Martyrs at Πολύστυλο of Kavala — which is not drafted. **A second entry on the same day page, «Όσιος Μαρδάριος ο Έγκλειστος» of the Lavra of the Caves, carries the same personal name as one of these five and is a different man; it is drafted as a new folder, `mardarius-the-recluse`.** The page prints an apolytikion naming all five, which is taken into each of the five folders, a kontakion naming Eustratius alone, which is taken into his, and a kathisma and an oikos, which are kinds the schema does not hold.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 26.12.2025 (13. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Евстратије, Аксентије, Евгеније, Мардарије и Орест.“

attestations.note: The second name of the day’s enumerated five; the heading is quoted whole on each of the five folders; URL year 2025. `types`: NOTHING ADDED, AND THAT IS A REFUSAL WORTH NAMING. The entry calls him «Аксентије свештеник», Auxentius THE PRIEST, and says the governors tortured him FIRST BECAUSE HE WAS A PRIEST — which is `presbyter` in §5’s table — but `i18n` and the vocabulary are not the obstacle here: the folder holds the bare `great-martyr` the other two calendars gave it, and a grade this reader would add on one word of one book, for a man the Romanian and Greek lines name without any rank of his own, is better named in the report than written. FOR THE AUTHOR: if the priesthood is to be recorded, `presbyter` is the type and this entry is the source. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND STILL ABSENT: the emperors and the governors are named without years. NO `locations`. NO `related` ROW ADDED: the four companions are already here in every direction, and `blaise-of-sebaste`, who communed Eustratius in prison, is Eustratius’s story and takes his row on that folder and not on this one. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Statornicia purtătorilor de biruinţă, cei cinci la număr: Sfinţii Mari Mucenici Eustratie şi Auxentie împreună cu ceilalţi luptători, înfruntând cu îndrăzneală focul şi celelalte chinuri, au primit de la Hristos cununile măririi; Căruia se şi roagă, să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mari Mucenici Eustratie, Auxentie, Evghenie, Mardarie și Orest (one hymn printed for the five together)

english.text: The steadfastness of the victory-bearers, five in number — the holy great martyrs Eustratius and Auxentius together with the rest of the contenders — boldly facing the fire and the other torments, received from Christ the crowns of glory; and to him they pray, that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ἡ πενταυγὴς τῶν ἀθλοφόρων χορεία, τῇ τῶν ἀγώνων νοητῇ δαδουχίᾳ, τὴν οἰκουμένην ἅπασαν αὐγάζει νοητῶς· ὁ σοφὸς Εὐστράτιος, σὺν Αὐξεντίῳ τῷ θείῳ, Ὀρέστης καὶ Μαρδάριος καὶ Εὐγένιος ἅμα, οὗς εὐφημοῦντες εἴπωμεν πιστοί· χαίροις μαρτύρων πεντάριθμε σύλλογε.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of the five martyrs. It names all five, so it is the company's own service and is taken into each of the five folders.

english.text: The fivefold-shining choir of the prize-winners lights the whole inhabited world with the spiritual torch of their contests: the wise Eustratius with the divine Auxentius, Orestes and Mardarius and Eugene together. Praising them, let us the faithful say: Rejoice, O five-numbered company of martyrs.

hymns.text: Мученик всечестных светлость,/ пяточисленных страстотерпцев воспоем,/ славу земных презревших,/ солнца светлаго Евстратия,/ премудраго витию со страдальцы,/ на огнь и муки дерзнувших за всех Царя Христа/ и от Престола Того славы почестьми венцев обдаренных./ Тех молитвами, Христе Боже,// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 декабря ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников», глас 4. The title names no one and the text is addressed to the five together — «пяточисленных страстотерпцев», the five-in-number passion-bearers — so it is written on all five of their folders. The two kontakia the day page prints beside it both close on the name of Eustratius and are written on his folder alone.

english.text: Let us hymn the brightness of the all-honoured martyrs, the five passion-bearers who despised the glory of earthly things — Eustratius the shining sun, the all-wise orator, with his fellow sufferers — who dared the fire and the torments for Christ the King of all, and were endowed from His throne of glory with the honour of crowns. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

death.note: The folder held no date of any kind and none of its other three calendars gives one. days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 13 декабря ст. ст. with «(284-305)», which is the reign of Diocletian and Maximian and not a year of death, so it is recorded as a traditional interval and not as attested.
